body: ![scientist leaving a nuculear bunker.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2250cb564bdf69b16711f673492a7bb652b8c88f_0.webp)Welcome to Ghost Battalion the ultimate military war experience! Lock 'n' loaded with a massive arsenal of weapons and armor, you can participate in epic PvP battles or explore the vast warzone. Fortify your base with strong resources because you'll need to stay discreet to protect your loot from raiders. Good luck, soldier! (dont update the mods it says too but it will break)
